label: Armada Tenebrium Crisis
blurb: Armada High Command has no Tenebrium left. They spent the black-hole distillate on a continent-scale swarm of autonomous decoy commanders — farming wind, solar, and converters across every scar they could hold. Their occupation eco is already paid for; their ability to field new build-power is frozen.

graph.notes: Q7 is the Tenebrium scarcity qubit; crisis keeps galactic pressure high even when the merc band finds flakes.
